people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

translations.web: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.
translations.bsb: I said: “You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.
translations.kjv: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give
translations.asv: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the hill-country of the Amorites, which Jehovah our God giveth unto us.
